facts.fact: WHO's SCORE assessment rates Zambia's civil registration and vital statistics system 'paper-based' on the attribute that all data are exchanged electronically from local to regional and then central offices; the assessment uses data from 2013-2018 and was updated 15 March 2021, so the last data year is used.

systems.tiers: local, regional and central offices; places to register births and deaths rated as 'coverage only in urban areas'

note: The same assessment gives completeness of birth registration 11% and of death registration 5%, and rates access to registration locations as urban only; these are shares of events and of access, not of offices entering digitally, so no offices fact is taken.
